title: I Did Not Like This Blanket At All
text:
I Did Not Like This Blanket At All. I Did Not Like the following:

The size was way off with the dimensions seemingly reversed. The sides were way too long, and the length from head to too way too short.

The Satin trim at the top edge felt cheap, and not a nice feeling on the underside.

The blanket did not feel as soft and cozy as expected.

I decided not to use it immediately.

I absolutely do not recommend this blanket.
